description: Advanced Sankey Diagram Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included Advanced Sankey Diagram renders multi-stage flow data as an interactive Sankey diagram, tracing how values move from stage to stage through connected nodes and proportionally sized ribbons. Node colors flow naturally into their ribbons via automatic gradients, while flows can be recolored manually or by conditional formatting rules. This enables business audiences to trace multi-step processes, such as customer journeys or conversion funnels, end to end, seeing where value is gained or lost. Key Capabilities Node-Driven Gradient Coloring: Ribbon colors flow from a node's color into its connected flows, with manual overrides available. Conditional Formatting: Color flows automatically by custom rules and thresholds, highlighting outliers at a glance. Click-to-Trace Interactivity: Select a node or flow to highlight its full upstream and downstream path. Horizontal and Vertical Layouts: Switch between left-to-right and top-to-bottom orientations to match any report. Value and Percentage Labels: Show values, percentage, or both, with control over units/decimals. Flexible Node Layout: Adjust alignment, width, and spacing to fine-tune the diagram.
